name: windows-sandbox-computer-use
description: Execute guest commands, batch tasks, share scoped directories and visually control Windows Sandbox.

interface.shortDescription: Guest commands and visual Sandbox control
interface.longDescription: Native wsb command execution, fail-fast batches, scoped directory sharing and IP queries, plus persistent IronRDP visual sessions with automatic screenshots. Command-only workflows need no RDP. Native exec returns exit codes, not stdout/stderr; guest accessibility trees and window enumeration are unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this Windows Sandbox is ready for visual control.
Share a debug directory read-only with this Windows Sandbox.
Control this Windows Sandbox and verify each action visually.
